text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... ha... ah.
Ah...—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
2,400 meters! I made it all the way to the end~...!
I did it...! *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san...! Thank... you... *whew*...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mmh... mgh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Battered and exhausted after finishing the race, Nishino Flower laid down for a while, barely able to savor the joy of victory.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes... but...
I'm sorry, just a little more... *phew*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower was heavily exhausted.
Today's victory was surely something she seized by pushing past her limits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, the next race would be the Shuka Sho—a medium-distance
race just like today's. However,
seeing how exhausted she is..."
choice_data_list: (Pushing any further will be tough. If anything—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was watching your race from here.
It was like a sudden gale,
such magnificent speed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. When that blooms... you will likely
find yourself facing each other directly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Nishino Flower has her own weapon.
A race where she can make the most of it is...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Thank you for waiting.
I've calmed down a bit now...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: Let's take the Shuka Sho off our goals.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...You mean... it's impossible for me
to go any further... don't you?
choice_data_list: I don't think it's completely impossible, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Indeed, she brought about a wonderful result today. Depending on her condition, running in the Shuka Sho is an option. However...
choice_data_list: There must be a stage where you can shine even brighter

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Shine...?
Does that mean...
choice_data_list: Why don't we try taking on sprint races from now on?
Why don't we try taking on sprint races from now on?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I'm a little relieved.
Deep down, I knew all along too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "The Oaks is an amazing race, and I really wanted to do my best, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it was hard for me...
There were painful times, too...!”
choice_data_list: Thank you for working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If it's a sprint, I'm sure I can
give it even more of my all. Let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"So... what should our goal be?
Given the timing, a summer graded race first, perhaps?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she thinks, easing in during the bustling summer
sprint races is one option. But with her potential—
she can aim for something far bigger!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Wait, that's a GⅠ, isn't it...?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Switching paths, right off the bat?
And what's more, the Senior-class older girls are running too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For Nishino Flower, this will be her first target race running alongside her senior Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Because I'm... just a 'kid,' after all, aren't I?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Going against older girls...
...Will I even stand a chance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower had always been self-conscious about still being young compared to the other girls. It was only natural that facing senior runners put pressure on her.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Still, the way I am right now...
choice_data_list: You can grow even more this summer

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Following this, the academy-sponsored summer training camp
will take place. It is said that an Umamusume's abilities
grow by leaps and bounds during the summer."
choice_data_list: I'll give it my all too, so let's get stronger together!
I'll do my best too, so let's get stronger together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I will follow you, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next goal was decided: the sprint GⅠ, the Sprinters Stakes.
